description: Engineering practice of defining build, test, and deployment workflows in version-controlled declarative code files.
Structured manifest specifying desired pipeline outcomes and dependencies rather than procedural shell commands.
Security framework (CICD-SEC-5) governing permissions and execution authorization for pipeline code changes.
Versioned, standardized pipeline template providing pre-configured build and security steps across repositories.
Supported, pre-packaged platform engineering path enabling application teams to ship code securely with minimal friction.
